message.content: I usually wake up around seven, maybe a bit later if I’ve had a rough night. I make a cup of tea and toast, then feed the cat before getting dressed. I take the bus to work, so I leave the house just in time to catch it. My sister and I live together, so she’s usually up too, but she’s still asleep most mornings. I like the routine—it keeps me grounded. I don’t really think about the voice much during the day, but sometimes I hear it when I’m alone. It’s not loud, just… there. I don’t know what it’s saying, but it’s not threatening. I just try to ignore it and keep going with my day.
